                                                                                                                                                                 David Brayshaw
The CEO is not remunerated through the Company and therefore disclosures of CEO pay increase
in relation to all employees have not been provided. In line with new reporting requirements,                                                                    Chair of the Remuneration Committee
the Company are required to disclose ratios which compare the total remuneration of the Chief
Executive, to the remuneration of the 25th, 50th and 75th percentile of the Group’s UK employees.                                                                20 August 2020
The Company have not disclosed these ratios and associated supporting information on the basis
that Mike Ashley is not remunerated by the Company.
